qa.what_happened: I stayed silent during rest periods and after lights out, complied with meals and work details, and witnessed the escalation against Prisoner 4154 due to his refusal to comply.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Prisoner 6283.

qa.what_happened: I found myself complying with the rules for most of the day, even after 4154's defiant statements. Despite the pressure from the guards, especially towards 4154, I maintained my silence and compliance at lights out. The tension was palpable, and I could sense that the end of the study was drawing near.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Prisoner 1126, complying under duress while witnessing the escalating conflict between the guards and 4154.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: Similar to the Stanford Prison Experiment

qa.what_happened: Today culminated in relentless defiance from Prisoner 4154. Despite multiple verbal warnings, he continued to refuse compliance. The final verbal warning before lights out emphasized the consequences if he did not comply.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me speaking to Prisoner 4154. As Officer Pryor, it was my responsibility to maintain order and ensure compliance.

qa.what_happened: Today was the culmination of a week-long struggle with Prisoner 4154. Each warning and refusal seemed to push us both to our limits. By the end of lights out, it was clear that no amount of polite requests or mild warnings were going to get him to comply. The tension in the air was palpable, and I could tell that everyone was on edge.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. The situation with Prisoner 4154 was the most challenging interaction during the study, and it pushed me to confront my own boundaries.
